Method of Attack: Injected javascript code on hacked legitimate websites scrambles page text and displays a fake Chrome Font Pack popup to trick users into downloading malware
Downloaded executable must be manually run by victim to infect system
Spora ransomware encrypts victim's data files and displays ransom note with payment options
Previous campaign installed Fleercivet Ad Clicking Trojan via Chrome_Font.exe
Current campaign installs Spora ransomware via Update.exe
Impacted Systems: Windows systems (implied by executable infection and ransomware behavior)
Attack Vector: Compromised legitimate websites with injected javascript
Social engineering via fake Chrome Font Pack popup prompting download and manual execution of malware
Indicators of Compromise: Fake popup stating missing 'HoeflerText' font and prompting Chrome Font Pack update
